subject: Next steps: vendor setup & procurement path options
messages:
From: Lauren Mills <lauren.mills@caduceus.co>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
Cc: AP Team <ap@caduceus.co>
Date: 2026-11-08T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor setup / PO vs card question after intro call

Thanks for the intro call earlier, Soojin — quick follow-up from procurement.

We want to start the vendor onboarding process but have a few clarification items before we proceed:
- Preferred commercial path: our default is PO (Net30) but we have vendor-card for smaller subscriptions; can you confirm if Redwood accepts PO invoices and supports Net30?
- Marketplace: is Redwood available through AWS Marketplace or GCP Marketplace for procurement? Any difference in billing or pricing when purchased that way?
- Vendor packet: we need a completed W-9 (or W-8 for foreign entities), banking/ACH instructions, and a vendor setup PDF with contact and indemnity details. Can you send those?

Attached: caduceus_vendor_packet.pdf (our internal intake form), W-9_Caduceus.pdf (for your reference).

AP contact for onboarding: AP Team <ap@caduceus.co> (please loop them in on any vendor portal/Docusign steps).

Timeline: target vendor activation by 2026-11-20 if possible.

Thanks,
Lauren Mills
Senior Procurement Manager
Caduceus Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
To: Lauren Mills <lauren.mills@caduceus.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, AP Team <ap@caduceus.co>
Date: 2026-11-08T15:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup / PO vs card question after intro call

Hi Lauren — great meeting you earlier. Appreciate the clear list; below is a concise recap and proposed next steps so we can get your vendor setup completed by your 11/20 target.

Recap / Options for procurement path:
1) Direct vendor setup (recommended for enterprise PO flows):
   - We can accept PO invoices; standard payment terms are Net30.
   - We will provide a vendor packet (completed W-9 on our side), Redwood bank details for ACH, and a one-page vendor setup checklist your AP team can follow.
2) Cloud marketplace (AWS/GCP):
   - We are listed on AWS Marketplace (Redwood Inference, private offers supported) — purchasing via marketplace uses AWS invoicing and may simplify centralized billing but can change how discounts/promotions are applied.
   - Marketplace purchases sometimes require different contract language; if you prefer marketplace, we can coordinate with your procurement and our channel team.
3) Card payments:
   - For smaller pilots or proofs-of-concept, we accept corporate cards. Larger enterprise deals typically go through PO.

Attachments I’m sending: redwood_vendor_setup_instructions.pdf (step-by-step), Redwood_W-9_filled.pdf (our completed tax form). Please note: I attached a stub here — I will push a DocuSign packet if you prefer the signed vendor packet route.

Next actions (proposed):
- Lauren / AP to confirm preferred path: PO or AWS Marketplace? Reply by 11/10 if possible.
- If PO: share your vendor onboarding contact and any internal forms we should complete (we’ll return the completed packet + bank details).
- If Marketplace: I’ll loop in our marketplace lead to confirm purchasing flow and any doc dependencies.
- I can schedule a 20-minute vendor onboarding call to walk AP through the portal/DocuSign flow.

I’ve cc’ed Marissa (who handles onboarding) to help with the packet and to set up the DocuSign envelope.

Best,
So Ijn (Soojin) Lee
Senior Account Executive, North America
Redwood Inference

From: AP Team <ap@caduceus.co>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
Cc: Lauren Mills <lauren.mills@caduceus.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup / PO vs card question after intro call

Hi Soojin / Marissa — thanks for the quick summary. Confirming our preference and providing the details you requested: 

1) Procurement path: PO (Net30) for the initial agreement — we prefer to have vendor invoices tied to a PO.
2) AP contact for routing / vendor portal: Christina Park <christina.park@caduceus.co>, +1 (415) 555-0198.
3) Required vendor packet items: completed vendor intake form (we attached caduceus_vendor_packet.pdf to Lauren earlier), W-9 (we shared ours — please return Redwood’s W-9), banking details for ACH (routing + account), and a signed vendor agreement (DocuSign is preferred).
4) Marketplace: we can consider AWS Marketplace for later if channel discounts are needed, but for now please proceed with direct vendor setup.

Timeline: Please return the completed vendor packet and vendor W-9 by 11/12 so we can route for PO issuance on 11/13.

Thanks,
AP Team (on behalf of Christina Park)
Caduceus Health Accounts Payable

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Lauren Mills <lauren.mills@caduceus.co>, AP Team <ap@caduceus.co>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-09T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup / PO vs card question after intro call

Hi Lauren / Christina — thanks for the confirmation. I’m Marissa from Onboarding — I’ll own the vendor packet and DocuSign flow. Quick plan: 

- I will attach and return Redwood_W-9_filled.pdf and redwood_vendor_setup_instructions.pdf to this thread.
- I’ll prepare a DocuSign envelope containing our standard vendor onboarding form + vendor agreement and send it to Christina (christina.park@caduceus.co) the same day.
- Once DocuSign is completed and we have your AP banking details, we’ll issue invoices to the PO you receive from procurement.

Proposed times for a 20-minute onboarding walkthrough (AP portal + DocuSign): 11/10 10:00–10:20 PT or 11/10 15:00–15:20 PT. Please confirm a slot and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Related HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/987654321 (for reference).

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
